title: Hyundai Santa Cruz: Dead or Alive for 2027? The Real Numbers
description:
In February, a report said the Hyundai Santa Cruz was being discontinued. Hyundai would not confirm it. Eight months later, Hyundai says the Santa Cruz continues for twenty twenty-seven. So which one is true? Both, in a way, and the numbers behind this little truck are stranger than the headlines. It sold twenty-five thousand units last year, and it is down twenty-eight percent this year, while its rival is up. Here is the real story.
